newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER - BESIKTAS HOLD OUT FOR DRAW IN WARSAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - BESIKTAS HOLD OUT FOR DRAW IN WARSAW.

text.p: A 70th minute goal by Kaynak Orhan gave Besiktas a 1-1 draw at Legia Warsaw on Tuesday in a UEFA Cup second round, first leg tie, dominated by the home side.
After a hectic begining striker Tomasz Sokolowski gave Legia the lead after 22 minutes and despite almost continous attacks on the Besiktas defence, the visitors held firm.

Nigerian Damiel Amokachi, Besiktas' busiest player, created the equaliser with a cross from a sharp angle which found the unmarked Orhan's whose powerful kick gave Lodz goalie Grzegorz Szamotulski no chance.
